Waikiki sucks!
Jun 2025 • Family
I'm an Expat living in Saigon. Today I made the mistake of visiting the waikiki bar & restaurant for lunch with my family. There was basically zero service. The blond hair young man found it more important to sit at the bar and talk with other staff rather than service customers. My wife our 2 teens and I ordered. After a long wait 3 of the 4 orders arrived. After the three of finished eating the 4th order still didn't arrive. Meanwhile our drinks are empty with no service. After the 4th meal came we refused it. The blond hair waiter was under apologetic. In fact he had a smug smile on the entire time. Drinks were ridiculously expensive in addition to having a service fee tacked on. This isn't the first bad experience with Waikiki. During a prior visit the staff tried to overcharge my credit card. After today's visit we stopped at a neighboring establishment. When sharing our experience with the staff we were told that our experience at Waikiki was common and many people have complained. Apparently they figure the customers are mostly foreigners on holiday so they don't care about complaints. Avoid this restaurant it's a tourist trap! We will never visit it again!
